yes.0: All right. Let me know by clicking the light bulb icon when you are ready.

1.0: Here, this is for you. Thank you for working so hard.

yes.0: You have the gift I gave you, yes? That marks you, #b#h0##k, as #bVirtue's Savior#k. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts to keep Maple World safe. I can only hope you continue to do so in the future.
